races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
LUCA BRILLANTE is progressing well and this represents a good opportunity back in a maiden. Blooming Sally only just failed to make a winning debut at Cork so is respected, while Be In Love makes most appeal of the newcomers.

  1. LUCA BRILLANTE (IRE)
  2. BLOOMING SALLY (IRE)
  3. BE IN LOVE (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF (C & G) Maiden
races.verdict:
SALT LAKE shaped well when only narrowly denied in a Curragh maiden on debut, pulling clear of the rest, and looks to hold leading claims of going one better. Our Boy Bailey has had excuses both starts since his promising debut and could be the main danger, ahead of Bold Commander.

  1. SALT LAKE (IRE)
  2. OUR BOY BAILEY (IRE)
  3. BOLD COMMANDER (IRE)

races.name: Goffs Two Million Series Maiden
races.verdict:
NEW BOND STREET left the impression a race of this nature is well within her compass when third in listed company last month. She can get off the mark. Abletai and Cyclone Code look the likeliest dangers.

  1. NEW BOND STREET
  2. ABLETAI (IRE)
  3. CYCLONE CODE (IRE)

races.name: Colm White Bookmakers Nursery Handicap
races.verdict:
SUMMER SENT YOU is progressing gradually and having made more impact than previously switched to a nursery when third at Down Royal earlier in the month, Ken Condon's filly gets the nod dropped to a sprint trip for the first time. Her main threat may emerge from Annie Batt, who has finished runner-up twice from her 3 outings and is now sent handicapping. Little Diva could sneak a place at forecast longer odds.

  1. SUMMER SENT YOU (IRE)
  2. ANNIE BATT (IRE)
  3. LITTLE DIVA (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Claiming Maiden
races.verdict:
SANTERNO looked to have more to offer when ninth in a strong Curragh maiden (form worked out well) last time and can build on it to gain a first win. Nando Royale rates a big threat if shrugging off a lesser effort at Roscommon though, while Cudawudashuda and Hazy Sky appeal as the pick of the rest for minor honours.

  1. SANTERNO (IRE)
  2. NANDO ROYALE (IRE)
  3. CUDAWUDASHUDA (IRE)

races.name: Care At Home Nursery Handicap
races.verdict:
OLD JOANIE gets the nod on the back of her placed effort at Killarney last time. Elyatta rates as the biggest threat after his Down Royal second, with Golden Arizona taken to complete the 1-2-3.

  1. OLD JOANIE (IRE)
  2. ELYATTA (IRE)
  3. GOLDEN ARIZONA (IRE)

races.name: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden
races.verdict:
STAR GLORY has found just one too strong in 2 of her 4 outings so far and with better yet still to come, Noel Meade's filly gets the nod to open her account. Capital of Pride again showed good speed when runner-up here last month, so he rates an obvious danger upped further in trip, with Dawnmore, Rosiliane and Diamonds And Dames just a handful of others worth considering, too.

  1. STAR GLORY (IRE)
  2. CAPITAL OF PRIDE (IRE)
  3. DAWNMORE (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
races.verdict:
VIENNA WALTZ is an interesting newcomer being a half-brother to smart 2-y-o 7f winner Raydara and useful 1m-1¼m winner Rondonia, and he can make a winning debut if the market speaks in his favour. Expensive purchase Miss Hong Kong is a sister to useful 2-y-o 1m winner Naval Force and poses the main threat on pedigree, while Soldat is another that needs considering.

  1. VIENNA WALTZ (IRE)
  2. MISS HONG KONG (IRE)
  3. SOLDAT (IRE)

races.name: Go Racing In Yorkshire Future Stars Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
GOOD KARMA signalled he is ready to go in again when a very good recent third at Thirsk so edges the vote in this tightknit sprint. One Of Our Own also comes here in fine fettle and rates a big threat, while 2024 victor Fiscal Policy and the quite lightly-raced Bloodsweatandtyres also need considering.

  1. GOOD KARMA
  2. ONE OF OUR OWN
  3. FISCAL POLICY (IRE)

races.name: Safe Point Sprint Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Quirky WHAT A GIRL WANTS is well capable of winning this, if rediscovering her early-season form on second start for Nigel Tinkler. Our Son Oscar and Ashina both hold solid claims, while Albert Mooney will be interesting if supported.

  1. WHAT A GIRL WANTS (IRE)
  2. OUR SON OSCAR (IRE)
  3. ASHINA (IRE)

races.name: Napoleons Casino Bradford Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Time has already shown SEA LANTERN faced a really stiff task conceding chunks of weight to a pair of upwardly-mobile 3-y-os in a 1¼m novice here back in the spring. That was his best effort yet and with the return to further a plus on handicap debut, Brian Ellison's charge looks to have plenty going for him returning from a break. Traveling Man and Morbeh can offer up chief resistance, in that order.

  1. SEA LANTERN
  2. TRAVELING MAN
  3. MORBEH

races.name: Nadeen Dawson Memorial Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
RIVER NILE sets a fair standard and may well open her account at the fourth attempt. The fly in the ointment could be Fan Me, who returns for a yard with an excellent record in maiden/novice events at this track.

  1. RIVER NILE (IRE)
  2. FAN ME
  3. DEVIL'S BRIGADE (IRE)

races.name: Matty Bown Handicap
races.verdict:
William Haggas' 3-y-o VENETIAN LION hasn't looked back since going handicapping and gets a confident vote to complete the hat-trick off a still very workable-looking mark. Hale End wasn't seen to ideal effect when runner-up at Southwell last time and appeals as the one to chase him home ahead of in-form duo Walsingham and Perfect Part.

  1. VENETIAN LION
  2. HALE END (IRE)
  3. WALSINGHAM (IRE)

races.name: Donate To New Beginnings Horses At nbhorses.org.uk Handicap
races.verdict:
DIGGER ONE is very much a late developer and looked one to keep firmly onside when following up his breakthrough Salisbury victory at Kempton 2 weeks ago, coming from near-last to first in under a furlong for no more than hands-and-heels riding. A 6 lb rise shouldn't prevent him making a bold bid to complete a quick-fire hat-trick, with An Bradan Feasa and No More Bolero fancied to pose the chief threats.

  1. DIGGER ONE
  2. AN BRADAN FEASA (IRE)
  3. NO MORE BOLERO

races.name: Pontefract Racecourse Racing Together Combatting Loneliness Handicap
races.verdict:
Andrew Balding's progressive filly THUNDER GODDESS went down only narrowly at Lingfield last time having been forced to challenge wide and looks very much the way to go from an unchanged mark. Dubai Venture goes really well around here and appeals as the one to chase her home ahead of the reliable Sunny Orange.

  1. THUNDER GODDESS
  2. DUBAI VENTURE (IRE)
  3. SUNNY ORANGE (IRE)

races.name: Moss And Co Hospitality Nursery
races.verdict:
CASABLANCA DREAM is bred to prove better at this longer trip and is fancied to make a winning start in nurseries, with the booking of Oisin Murphy very much catching the eye. Whiskey Galore is also shortlisted after his Lingfield second, with Ariane Sky also holding strong claims.

  1. CASABLANCA DREAM (IRE)
  2. WHISKEY GALORE
  3. ARIANE SKY (IRE)

races.name: Infobond EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
WYKEHURST PARK shaped with promise ahead of a next-time-out winner on debut. There's surely improvement to come, and he could get off the mark with Oisin Murphy taking over. Crown Ranger is feared most ahead of interesting newcomer Howluckyweare, with Cracking Idea also respected in an open-looking maiden.

  1. WYKEHURST PARK
  2. CROWN RANGER (IRE)
  3. HOWLUCKYWEARE

races.name: Dan Hague, Rails Bookmaker Nursery
races.verdict:
CATCHING DREAMS may have found the relatively quick turnaround catching him out when beaten at short odds at Sandown 6 weeks ago and with his Lingfield debut effort a promising one, Charlie Appleby's colt appeals as the type to get back on the up now tackling a nursery for the first time. Sydney Grace is going the right way and heads up the dangers along with Dubai Charm and Soldier Of The Sea.

  1. CATCHING DREAMS
  2. SYDNEY GRACE (IRE)
  3. DUBAI CHARM (IRE)

races.name: Boodles Handicap
races.verdict:
Lightly-raced for his age, MIDNIGHT THUNDER got back on the up when beaten only by a fellow improver at Thirsk last time and he can build on that effort to resume winning ways. Heading the list of dangers is Pilu, who gained a first handicap success at Newmarket on his latest outing, with Purosangue also one to note from his reduced mark.

  1. MIDNIGHT THUNDER
  2. PILU (IRE)
  3. PUROSANGUE

races.name: Goffs Two Million Series Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
The fact DIVINE KNIGHT has been a beaten a favourite for this yard 4 times from 5 starts is off-putting, but a final chance is given to William Haggas' 5-y-o with Tom Marquand up for the first time. Heading up the dangers is Zachary Hickes, who was unable to live with the gambled-on winner at Goodwood last month but remains with potential. Heroics and St Mawes can fight out third spot.

  1. DIVINE KNIGHT (IRE)
  2. ZACHARY HICKES
  3. HEROICS

races.name: White Swan Fishermans Fortune Handicap
races.verdict:
PICKERING CASTLE took advantage of his reduced mark when edging out his in-form stablemate over C&D last time and he remains well treated off 3 lb higher. Viking Glory and Emery Down head the dangers.

  1. PICKERING CASTLE
  2. VIKING GLORY (IRE)
  3. EMERY DOWN

races.name: LA Continental Cafe Of Great Yarmouth Handicap
races.verdict:
Preference is for TIMELY AFFAIR, who made it back-to-back wins when scoring at Lingfield last month and he can add to his tally in his current form. Eduardo Calderon conceded first run when second at Epsom recently and is feared most with more still to offer over this trip, ahead of Dashing Dick.

  1. TIMELY AFFAIR
  2. EDUARDO CALDERON (IRE)
  3. DASHING DICK (IRE)

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Nursery
races.verdict:
WOPBOPALOOMOP transformed when winning a competitive 14-runner nursery at Windsor 10 days ago after a 4-month break, proving strong at the finish over this trip, and she can defy her penalty if this doesn't come too soon. Secret Rival went with more zest at Newcastle last time and shaped as if back in form, so is feared most, while Crowned has form to make an impact but his stable have been quiet of late.

  1. WOPBOPALOOMOP
  2. SECRET RIVAL (IRE)
  3. CROWNED (IRE)

races.name: Follow AtTheRaces On X Handicap
races.verdict:
Having opened his account at Nottingham in April, STANIEL CAY has shaped a bit better than the bare result on each of his 2 starts for Grant Tuer and he could be worth chancing now returned to this longer trip. Von Krolock and Willolarupi head up the dangers, with Insuspense another to keep an eye on.

  1. STANIEL CAY (IRE)
  2. VON KROLOCK (IRE)
  3. WILLOLARUPI (IRE)

races.name: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
LEVEL LOOK relished the longer trip when making all at Wolverhampton (1¾m) 10 days ago and is the obvious choice to follow up under a 6-lb penalty, especially with the step up to 2m promising to suit. Dojin is building a good strike rate and is feared most.

  1. LEVEL LOOK
  2. DOJIN
  3. NEW YORK MINUTE (IRE)

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
STORM FORCE TEN confirmed the improvement shown at Salisbury in spite of being kept to 6f at Ascot last time, so he’s an appealing candidate now stepping back up in trip in what looks a weaker novice. Bullrider has been gelded since a disappointing run at Southwell 6 weeks ago and has leading claims if bouncing back to form, while Galactic Affair is a newcomer to keep an eye on in the betting for a respected yard.

  1. STORM FORCE TEN (IRE)
  2. BULLRIDER (IRE)
  3. GALACTIC AFFAIR (IRE)

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
DONTWORRYABOUTME offered something to work on when mid-field in a maiden at Glorious Goodwood and he can find the required improvement to beat Peaberry and Don't Stop Movin.

  1. DONTWORRYABOUTME (IRE)
  2. PEABERRY
  3. DON'T STOP MOVIN

races.name: Free Bets On attheraces.com Selling Handicap
races.verdict:
ROI DE COEUR proved he's still on the upgrade when pulling clear with the winner over C&D late last month and he looks capable of defying a 2 lb rise. Cool Molly has an excellent record on the all-weather so is second choice on her return to this surface.

  1. ROI DE COEUR (IRE)
  2. COOL MOLLY (IRE)
  3. INDEFENSIBLE (IRE)

races.name: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap
races.verdict:
ROYAL COUNTY GLORY has really turned the corner since joining Jack Jones and a 6 lb penalty may not prevent him completing the hat-trick here. Captain Cess and Sailor's Return rate the principal dangers.

  1. ROYAL COUNTY GLORY (IRE)
  2. CAPTAIN CESS (IRE)
  3. SAILOR'S RETURN

races.name: Free Race Replays On attheraces.com Handicap
races.verdict:
Preference is for MIMIME, who arrives on the back of a career best here a fortnight ago and is still low mileage. Beach Partee and One For Harvey should also go well.

  1. MIMIME (IRE)
  2. BEACH PARTEE
  3. ONE FOR HARVEY

races.name: Download The At The Races App Novice Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict:
It's been some time since GOLSPIE got his head in front but he ran well in a stronger contest here last month and is 2 lb lower now. He gets the nod in the finale. The Pug and Glitter Code can also make their presence felt.

  1. GOLSPIE (IRE)
  2. THE PUG (IRE)
  3. GLITTER CODE (IRE)

races.name: Almins Vantage/Lallemand Magniva Classic EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Improving Wootton Bassett filly BASSRAH sets a fair standard and may well make it fourth time lucky. Zarak Crown, Perfect Heir and Magwitch could show plenty more than on their respective debuts, while a couple of well-bred newcomers need a close look in the betting.

  1. BASSRAH
  2. ZARAK CROWN (FR)
  3. PERFECT HEIR

races.name: Brandinghub For Signs & Graphics Handicap
races.verdict:
ORIENTAL PRINCE gets the vote, with the form of his recent York win starting to work out well. Hat-trick-seeking Startling is next best, while Knicks could prove himself well treated if things fall right. Never Dark makes each-way appeal and completes the shortlist for this ultra-competitive sprint.

  1. ORIENTAL PRINCE
  2. STARTLING
  3. KNICKS (IRE)

races.name: British Stallion Studs Scottish Premier Series EBF Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
DARZAH ticks plenty of boxes and can resume winning ways on first start over 1¼m. Valley of Flowers looks as good as ever and may take the silver.

  1. DARZAH
  2. VALLEY OF FLOWERS (IRE)
  3. GEO (IRE)

races.name: Ladbrokes 'Bet 5 Get 30 New Customer Offer' Kilkerran Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
IMPARTIALITY has been knocking on the door and can land deserved compensation here. Tiernan, Altareq and Wild Thoughts also appeal, in what looks a competitive renewal of this relatively valuable handicap.

  1. IMPARTIALITY
  2. TIERNAN (IRE)
  3. ALTAREQ

races.name: IDP Supporting Care Through Better Purchasing Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
HAVANA TOUCH has been in the form of his life on the all-weather recently. He's the one to beat if translating that to turf at the fourth time of asking, with improving 3-y-o Tarmonbarry Kid likely to prove a serious danger. Orangesandlemons, Second Fiddle and Runninsonofagun are others to consider in a competitive handicap.

  1. HAVANA TOUCH
  2. TARMONBARRY KID (IRE)
  3. ORANGESANDLEMONS

races.name: IDP Supporting Care Through Better Purchasing Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
SAILTHISSHIPALONE has been consistent since joining this yard but finds himself back below last winning mark and this looks a good opportunity back down in grade. You Sexy Thing is lightly raced and is another dropping in grade after a return from a break so could reveal more, while Green Pursuit is only just starting out over this trip and did enough to think it suited last time.

  1. SAILTHISSHIPALONE
  2. YOU SEXY THING (IRE)
  3. GREEN PURSUIT (IRE)

races.name: Ladbrokes 'Get Racing Bet Builder Winnings Boosts' Handicap
races.verdict:
ICE CUBE took a while to hit full stride when finishing fourth at Epsom on his latest outing 5 weeks ago, yet he'd looked one to keep on side in this sort of company when scoring at that venue previously and could well be worth chancing to resume progress for a stable enjoying a highly-productive season. Multiple C&D winner Jkr Cobbler and Vince Le Prince head up the dangers, along with Jet Warrior and Ey Up Its Jazz.

  1. ICE CUBE (IRE)
  2. JKR COBBLER (IRE)
  3. VINCE LE PRINCE

races.name: Tennent's Lager Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
This looks wide open and with that in mind it could pay to take a chance on MINSTREL KNIGHT. He's been absent since shaping as if amiss at Thirsk back in the spring but with easier ground in his favour from what appeals as a handy mark, he may represent a spot of value with his yard enjoying a really productive season. Ashnak shaped better than the distance beaten suggests at Haydock last time and is next best ahead of Elsass.

  1. MINSTREL KNIGHT
  2. ASHNAK (FR)
  3. ELSASS (IRE)

races.name: Prix Violon II Listed Handicap Chase
Prix De Mehun Sur Yevre - Attele
